title: Horticulture Bihar – बागवानी योजनाएँ और अनुदान
organization: Directorate of Horticulture, Government of Bihar
postName: Bihar Horticulture Schemes and Subsidy Services
vacancyDetails: Horticulture schemes, plantation support, crop assistance and subsidy applications for Bihar beneficiaries.
qualification: Farmers and applicants eligible under the relevant Bihar horticulture scheme.
ageLimit: As per the concerned horticulture scheme.
selectionProcess: Online scheme application -> Department scrutiny -> Approval -> Subsidy or assistance
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, bank details, land or beneficiary details, mobile number and scheme-specific documents.
howToApply: Visit the official Horticulture Bihar portal and open the relevant scheme or subsidy application service.
shortDescription: Official Bihar Horticulture portal for बागवानी योजनाएँ, farmer assistance and subsidy applications.
content:
The Bihar Horticulture portal publishes state horticulture schemes, assistance programmes and subsidy application information.

Farmers can review plantation, crop, nursery and horticulture support programmes available in Bihar.

Check the latest scheme notice for eligibility, documents, application dates, district availability and beneficiary selection rules before applying online.
